## Project: Online Clothing Store
**Type:** Web Application (Next.js / React / Node.js) + Mobile-Friendly

**Core Purpose:** A Pakistani e-commerce clothing store with product listings, cart, JazzCash/Easypaisa checkout, admin panel, and order tracking.

### 🎨 Frontend / UI Tasks
- [ ] Design and build homepage with hero section and category navigation
- [ ] Product listing page with filters (size, color, price)
- [ ] Single product detail page with image gallery and add-to-cart
- [ ] Shopping cart page with quantity controls
- [ ] Checkout flow — shipping info form + payment selection
- [ ] Order tracking page (customer enters order ID)
- [ ] Mobile-responsive layout for all pages

### ⚙️ Backend / API Tasks
- [ ] Product CRUD API (create, read, update, delete)
- [ ] Cart management API (guest + logged-in users)
- [ ] Order placement API
- [ ] Order status update API (for admin)
- [ ] Payment initiation and callback handler for JazzCash
- [ ] Payment initiation and callback handler for Easypaisa

### 🗄️ Database Tasks
- [ ] Products schema (name, price, images, sizes, colors, stock)
- [ ] Orders schema (items, customer info, status, tracking number)
- [ ] Users/customers schema (assumed)

### 🔌 Integrations & Third-Party
- [ ] JazzCash payment gateway integration
- [ ] Easypaisa payment gateway integration
- [ ] Email notification on order confirmation (assumed)

### 🔐 Auth & Security
- [ ] Customer account creation and login
- [ ] Admin login with role-based access (admin vs customer)
- [ ] Secure API routes (admin endpoints protected)

### 🚀 Deployment & Hosting
- [ ] Deploy frontend on Vercel
- [ ] Deploy backend/API (Vercel serverless or separate Node server)
- [ ] MongoDB Atlas or similar DB setup

### 🧪 Testing & QA
- [ ] Test full checkout flow with JazzCash sandbox
- [ ] Test order tracking with sample orders
- [ ] Cross-device mobile testing (Android + iOS browsers)

**Complexity estimate:** Medium-High — two payment gateways + admin panel + order tracking together make this a full-featured store; most complexity is in the payment integrations.

### ❓ Questions to Ask Client Before Starting
1. Do customers need to create accounts, or can they checkout as guests?
2. Is there an existing product catalog I can import, or will products be added fresh through the admin panel?
3. Do you need a separate mobile app (Flutter/React Native), or is mobile-responsive web enough?
4. For JazzCash and Easypaisa — do you already have a merchant account with them, or does that need to be set up first?
5. Should the admin panel show sales reports/revenue charts, or just basic order management?
6. Is Urdu language support needed anywhere (product names, checkout, emails)?
